observations: Photo 0: a gold coloured slim games console held in a hand, PlayStation logo on the top face.
Photo 0: thin two-tier body with rounded edges and a PS logo on the front corner, the shape of a PS4 Slim.
Photo 0: top surface looks clean with no visible scratches at this low resolution.
Photo 0: a second gold console and a stack of black consoles behind it, in what looks like a shop.
Photo 0: watermark 'HYMAN GADGETS HUB' over the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 top surface looks clean, though only one side is shown at low resolution.
Photo 0 gold slim body with PS logo matches a gold PS4 Slim edition.

claims.claim: Comes with controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: No controller or accessories in photo 0.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Opening leaves no sign a photo can prove; warranty seal not shown.
No powered-on screen or gameplay clip.
No receipt or warranty card shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, read discs, or may overheat.
risks.proof: Clip powering on to the home screen and running a game from disc, with a handwritten note with today's date in shot.
Photo of the label under the console or the Settings > Storage screen.

risks.risk: Controller missing or faulty (drift, dead buttons).
risks.proof: Photo of the controller and a clip of it paired and moving in the menu.

risks.risk: Console banned from PSN or account locked.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the console signed in to PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: Serial may not match the receipt, or unit may be stolen.
risks.proof: Photo of the serial label beside the receipt.

proof_requests: Clip of the console powering on and playing a disc, with a handwritten note with today's date in shot
Photo of the serial and storage label under the console
Photo of the controller and all included accessories laid out
Photo of the receipt and warranty next to the console serial
response.reason: The PlayStation logo and slim body in photo 0 identify a gold PS4 Slim, so it can be priced at its worst case: 500GB, console only, as not working until a power-on clip is shown.
